avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inducer reduces verapamil plasma concentrations and therapeutic efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; may require verapamil dose adjustment if discontinued

avoid_supplements.name: Grapefruit Seed Extract
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibitor increases verapamil bioavailability and risk of toxicity

avoid_supplements.name: Calcium Supplements (high-dose)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: May antagonize verapamil's calcium channel blocking effects
avoid_supplements.action: Use lowest effective dose; monitor blood pressure and heart rate closely

caution_supplements.name: Hawthorn
caution_supplements.mechanism: May have additive cardiovascular effects and hypotensive potential
caution_supplements.action: Monitor blood pressure; inform healthcare provider of concurrent use

caution_supplements.name: Garlic
caution_supplements.mechanism: Theoretical additive antiplatelet and hypotensive effects
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for increased bleeding risk and blood pressure changes

caution_supplements.name: Magnesium Supplements
caution_supplements.mechanism: May have additive effects on cardiac conduction and blood pressure
caution_supplements.action: Use at standard doses; monitor cardiac rhythm if high doses used

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit and Grapefruit Juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition dramatically increases verapamil plasma levels, increasing hypotension, bradycardia, and AV block risk
avoid_foods.action: Complete avoidance required; even small amounts can significantly alter drug levels

caution_foods.name: High-Fat Meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May increase verapamil absorption and peak plasma concentrations
caution_foods.action: Take consistently with or without food to maintain stable drug levels

caution_foods.name: Caffeine-Containing Foods/Beverages
caution_foods.mechanism: May have opposing effects on heart rate; high caffeine could reduce verapamil benefits
caution_foods.action: Moderate caffeine intake; monitor heart rate response

monitoring_notes: Monitor blood pressure, heart rate, and signs of AV block (dizziness, syncope, chest discomfort) regularly. Baseline ECG and periodic monitoring recommended, especially when initiating or adjusting doses.
